guideline_item_description: Identify the study as developing and/or validating a prediction model using AI/ML
explanation_and_evidence: Title specifies 'Leakage, Imbalance Handling, Calibration, and Temporal Generalization in BRFSS-Based Heart Disease Classification'; abstract explicitly defines supervised machine learning classification.

guideline_item_description: Explain the medical context and rationale for the model
explanation_and_evidence: Contextualizes cardiovascular disease burden, role of public health telephone surveys (BRFSS), and widespread methodological pitfalls in published survey AI.

guideline_item_description: Specify key objectives and research questions
explanation_and_evidence: Clearly lists the primary question (impact of leakage, imbalance, thresholds, and temporal generalization) and two supporting questions.

guideline_item_description: Present key elements of study design early in the paper
explanation_and_evidence: Presents 80/20 partitioned development cohort in 2020 and out-of-time external validation cohorts in 2021 and 2022; Figure 1 flow diagram.

guideline_item_description: Describe the setting locations and relevant dates
explanation_and_evidence: Details CDC nationwide telephone surveillance system across 50 US states, DC, and territories for survey years 2020, 2021, and 2022.

guideline_item_description: Give eligibility criteria and sources/methods of selection
explanation_and_evidence: Describes non-institutionalized community-dwelling US adult respondents aged 18+; details complete-case inclusion and exclusion criteria.

guideline_item_description: Clearly define the outcome to be classified or predicted
explanation_and_evidence: Mandatory framing: self-reported lifetime physician-diagnosed myocardial infarction or coronary heart disease (_MICHD); excludes prospective risk.

guideline_item_description: Clearly define all candidate predictors and feature groups
explanation_and_evidence: Defines 17 features grouped into Demographics, Behavioral Lifestyle, General Health, and Functional/Clinical Morbidity; Table 2 crosswalk.

guideline_item_description: For each variable of interest give data sources and details of assessment
explanation_and_evidence: Provides CDC variable names, survey interview questions, response code mappings, and standardization formulas across 2020-2022.

guideline_item_description: Describe how missing data were handled
explanation_and_evidence: Quantifies complete-case retention (79.5% in 2021, 76.2% in 2022); details BMI and alcohol non-response; presents SleepTime median imputation vs NaN sensitivity.

guideline_item_description: Describe all machine learning algorithms and hyperparameter optimization
explanation_and_evidence: Details XGBoost, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Balanced Random Forest; specifies exact hyperparameters, early stopping, and loss functions.

guideline_item_description: Describe resampling and imbalance handling methods without data leakage
explanation_and_evidence: Formally separates clean training-only resampling from invalid pre-split SMOTE negative control; audits class weighting, SMOTE ratios, SMOTE-NC, and BRF.

guideline_item_description: Specify the methods used to calibrate probabilities
explanation_and_evidence: Evaluates uncalibrated XGBoost probabilities, Platt sigmoid scaling, and isotonic regression; reports Brier score, log loss, ECE, calibration slope and intercept.

guideline_item_description: Specify decision threshold selection objective and rule
explanation_and_evidence: Explicitly details training out-of-fold grid search targeting 80% sensitivity (tau=0.0816); contrasts with default tau=0.50 and Max-F1.

guideline_item_description: Describe survey weighting and complex sampling design methods
explanation_and_evidence: Applies Taylor series linearization for stratified clustered sampling (_LLCPWT, _STSTR, _PSU); reports point estimates, design effects (DEFF), and 95% CIs.

guideline_item_description: Report model performance metrics with confidence intervals
explanation_and_evidence: Reports ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, Sensitivity, Specificity, PPV, NPV, Brier score, and ECE with 95% bootstrap and design-based confidence intervals across all tables.

guideline_item_description: Report subgroup analyses and evaluate fairness/disparity
explanation_and_evidence: Presents stratified evaluation across age groups (<50, 50-69, 70+), biological sex, and 6 racial/ethnic categories; distinguishes AUC drop from threshold disparity.

guideline_item_description: Describe temporal external validation on independent cohorts
explanation_and_evidence: Evaluates frozen 2020 model on 348,568 respondents (2021) and 339,264 respondents (2022) with zero parameter updates, retraining, or recalibration.

guideline_item_description: Discuss limitations and non-causal interpretation
explanation_and_evidence: Provides 12 explicit limitation subpoints; prohibits prospective risk, survival, clinical deployment, and causal risk-factor modification claims.

guideline_item_description: Provide code
explanation_and_evidence: Section 12 & Appendix
column8: Reports exact SHA-256 model hashes, crosswalk specifications, data pipeline scripts, and environment reproducibility instructions.
